name: Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email
plain: Apple signs the person in and can give the app a random relay email instead of the real one.
meaning: Stops the app from using email as a cross-site key; hash matching in UID2 and RampID fails against relay addresses.

android.note: Credential Manager and Google Sign-In return the real email.

ios.prompt_ui: Share My Email or Hide My Email
ios.revocation: Settings > Apple ID > Sign in with Apple
ios.store_policy: App Review 4.8: offer an equivalent login if you offer other logins (relaxed Jan 2024)
ios.note: Developers must register email domains/senders with Apple to relay mail.

data.metric: Stable per-team user ID and optional relay email

limits.headline: Can sign you in on iPhone and give the app a random relay email instead
limits.user_action: You tap Sign in with Apple and choose Share My Email or Hide My Email
can: Sign you in with your Apple account
Give the app your real email, if you pick Share My Email
Give the app a random relay address, if you pick Hide My Email
Forward the app's emails to you through Apple's relay
cannot: Reveal your real email when you pick Hide My Email
Send email to you unless the developer registered its sending domain with Apple
Work on Android; Google Sign-In and Credential Manager return the real email
limits.differs: iPhone only. Android sign in always returns your real email.

story.what_it_is: Apple signs you in and can give the app a random fake email that forwards to you.

marketing.name: Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email
marketing.pitch: Pitch: sign in quickly and keep your real email private with a random address that forwards to you.

marketing.name: Hide My Email
marketing.pitch: Support page: create unique random email addresses that forward to your inbox, so you do not share your real one.

story.for_you: You tap Sign in with Apple, use Face ID, and pick Hide My Email. The app gets a random address that forwards to you. You can turn it off any time, which stops that app's emails.
story.for_makers: Makers get a fast sign up with less typing and fewer fake accounts. They lose the real email as a way to link people across ads and sites, and they must send mail through Apple's relay.

use_cases.example: You sign up for a store and give it a random address, so a data leak or sale of its list never exposes your real email.
A game offers Sign in with Apple so you start in seconds and keep your email private.
A newsletter site uses the relay so you can cut off emails with one tap in Settings.
A dating app lets you sign up without sharing your main email or phone.
An ad firm cannot match a relay address to the same person's other accounts.
Apple's sign in lowers fake account sign ups because each one needs a real Apple account.

risks: Apps may force an Apple account
story.android_note: Android has no matching feature. Google offers its own Sign in with Google with real emails.
story.ios_note: Built into iOS and Apple accounts. Developers must offer it when they offer other social sign ins.

technical_bounds: Real name only on first sign in

legit_uses: Account creation without handing out an email
abuse: Marketing with a real email via consent

history.change: Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email
Token revocation required for account deletion (30 June 2022)
